 Appearance:
 Shri Shashank Upadhyay - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri D. K. Shukla - Panel Lawyer for respondent/ State.
Shri Sandeep Mahawar - Advocate for the objector.

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.06/2024, dated 04.01.2024, registered at Police Station-Moghat Road, District - Khandwa (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC and under Section 25/27 of Arms Act.
Applicant is in detention since 01.8.2024.

Applicant's fist bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after filing of charge sheet vide order dated 10.9.2024, passed in M.Cr.C.No.38395/2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, applicant who was working as Cashier in HDFC Bank, withdrew money in collusion with co-accused Dinesh Patel and also forged documents.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Charge NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:1157 2 MCRC-52968-2024 sheet has already been filed.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as objector have opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5 . Charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant is first offender.
Final conclusion of the trial will take considerable time.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 483 of BNSS. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Sumit be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
